title: Separating mixing from selection: a leave-one-line-out benchmark for cross-cell-line perturbation prediction
description: Analysis code and derived per-target scores for a leave-one-line-out benchmark of cross-cell-line perturbation prediction. Tier A holds out each of four harmonized cell lines (K562, RPE1, HepG2, Jurkat; 5,486 queries); Tier B holds out each of five heterogeneous lines (H1, K562, RPE1, HCT116, HEK293T; 18,678 queries). The archive contains the analysis scripts, summary tables, manuscript source, figures, and the per-target arrays needed to rerun the headline audit. The largest prediction arrays and raw row caches are deposited as separate files. The analysis code is MIT-licensed; derived data and figures are CC BY 4.0. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed and remain under their original licenses.
